SUMMARY:
This Final Plat proposes to subdivide a total of8.82 acres, consisting of 8.00 acres of vacant property
and.82 acres of vacated portions of Van Buren Avenue and Cheyenne Street into threelots.The
subject property is located onthe east side of the City on the northeast corner of Polk Avenue and
Pershing Boulevard.This Final Plat is being requested in conjunction with a Street Vacation, a Zone
Change request fromAG Agricultural Residential toLI Light Industrial and a proposal to construct
commercial storage facilities on the site.The Street Vacation and Zone Change arebeing processed
3

concurrently with this Final Plat.Street improvements and a Greenway path are planned for Polk
Avenue.The applicant is dedicating5’of additional right-of-way toward the development of the
Greenway as well as a 20’drainage easement for storm water drainage.Furthermore, the applicant is
aware that he will be required to reimburse the Cityfor50% of Polk Avenue's Road and Greenway
construction costs for the portion of the road and path which is adjacent to the subject property.The
construction ofthe storage park is proposed tobe completedin phases; beginning withthe buildout
of the north lot and then moving south down the property.The applicant is proposing to install
sanitary sewerlines, a detention pond andwater linesforthe property before the Citybegins
construction of the Polk Avenue Road and Greenway.An expectation of right-of-way improvements
along Pershing Boulevard has alsobeen communicated to the applicant.The details of suchwill be
determined at the time of the southlot's development.Minimum required Civic Open Spaceis not
required in the LI zoning district thus none is being pursued with this application.However, the final
plat will require payment of Park Development fees.
FINAL PLAT DATA:
The applicant is proposing to subdivide a total of 8.82 acres into three lots. These lots will be
2.53 acres, and the south lot 2.55 acres.This final plat is being requested in conjunction witha
proposal to change the zoning from AG Agricultural Residential to LI Light Industrial and to
construct commercial storage facilities on the site.After review of a Traffic Worksheet by the
City's Traffic Engineer it was determined that the Traffic Study requirement could be waived.
However, if development occurs in a manner which does not keep with the land use assumptions
provided in the Traffic Worksheet a TIA or TIS may be required.With this application, a
Drainage Study as well as an Environmental Impact Assessment were required and submitted.
Because no new streets were proposed with this application, a Transportation Network Plan was
not required.Also, because the proposed LI zoning district does not have a Civic Open Space
requirement, an Open Space Worksheet was not required.
FINAL PLAT REVIEW CRITERIA ANALYSIS:
Inreviewing, providing comments, and making recommendations and decisions on aproposed
preliminary plat, the Staff, Planning Commission and City Council shall use the following
criteria:
1.Thelayout and design of thefinal plat isin substantial compliance with the approved
preliminary plat considering thenumberof lots orparcels, street andblock layout, and
with the Comprehensive Plan.
The subject property was annexed to the City in 2005 with AR Agricultural Residential zoning
and has not been rezoned since that time.The 8.82 acre parcel is square in shape and measures
approximately 617'x 626'. The parcel is located on the northeast side of the City along Pershing
Boulevard and east of Polk Avenue.To the west, U.S.30 crosses Pershing Boulevard at a 45
degree angle which chops the areainto a triangle and creates a physical barrier between the
subject property and the residential land uses to the north.Dry Creek cuts along the northeast
corner of the subject property and as a result portions of this corner reside ina FEMA floodway
ora100-year FEMA floodplain.
